title: Audit candidate transformations of the SPP1+TAM cross-scale design
invariants: Cross-scale immune ecology and patient-level evidence structure
learning_objective: Learn to audit and adapt a cross-scale tumor-immune ecology study without overclaiming
target_contribution: A bounded publishable public-data study rather than an automatic top-tier mechanistic claim
novelty_floor: At least one substantive new question, evidence link, or boundary beyond renaming a cancer, cell, or gene
ambition_ceiling: No causal or therapeutic-synergy claim without independent intervention evidence; complexity must remain executable for a beginner-led project
feasibility_summary: Public observational data support association and spatial validation; causal intervention requires new data
claim_ceiling: Association, external validation, and spatial localization until intervention evidence is available
